verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य ततः अस्त्राणि प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः ।गच्छन् एव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-२८-१॥
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya tataḥ astrāṇi prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śuciḥ ।gacchan eva ca kākutstho viśvāmitram atha abravīt ॥1-28-1॥

translations.english: After performing the purificatory rites, Rama received the weapons with a cheerful face. In the way Rama said to Viswamitra.

verses.sloka: गृहीत अस्त्रो अस्मि भगवन् दुराधर्षः सुरैः अपि ।अस्त्राणाम् तु अहम् इच्छामि संहारम् मुनिपुंगव ॥१-२८-२॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhīta astro asmi bhagavan durādharṣaḥ suraiḥ api ।astrāṇām tu aham icchāmi saṁhāram munipuṁgava ॥1-28-2॥

translations.english: "O venerable one, having received these weaponsI have become unassailable even by the celestials. O best of ascetics, May I know the way to withdraw these weapons".
translations.hindi: अपने पिता की आज्ञा. से और उनकी बात रखने के लिए आपके कथनानुसार निःशङ्क हो कर, कार्य करना, मेरा कत्तव्य है

verses.sloka: एवम् ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महा तपाः ।संहारान् व्याजहार अथ धृतिमान् सुव्रतः शुचिः ॥१-२८-३॥
verses.transliteration: evam bruvati kākutsthe viśvāmitro mahā tapāḥ ।saṁhārān vyājahāra atha dhṛtimān suvrataḥ śuciḥ ॥1-28-3॥

translations.english: To these words spoken by Rama, maharshi Viswamitra who was patient practitioner of vows and pure taught the withdrawl mantra.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि महाराज ने गुरु . वसिष्ठ जी के सामने, अयोध्या से प्रस्थान करते समय, मुझे यह्‌ आज्ञा दी है। अतः मैं उस आज्ञा की अवज्ञा नहीं कर सकता

verses.sloka: सत्यवन्तम् सत्य कीर्तिम् धृष्टम् रभसम् एव च ।प्रतिहारतरम् नाम पराङ्मुखम् अवाङ्मुखम् ॥१-२८-४॥
verses.transliteration: satyavantam satya kīrtim dhṛṣṭam rabhasam eva ca ।pratihārataram nāma parāṅmukham avāṅmukham ॥1-28-4॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्या अलक्ष्याः इमौ चैव दृढ नाभ सुनाभकौ ।दशाक्ष शतवक्त्रौ च दश शीर्ष शत उदरौ ॥१-२८-५॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣyā alakṣyāḥ imau caiva dṛḍha nābha sunābhakau ।daśākṣa śatavaktrau ca daśa śīrṣa śata udarau ॥1-28-5॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

verses.sloka: पद्मनाभ महानाभौ दुन्दुनाभ स्वनाभकौ ।ज्योतिषम् शकुनम् चैव नैराश्य विमलौ उभौ ॥१-२८-६॥
verses.transliteration: padmanābha mahānābhau dundunābha svanābhakau ।jyotiṣam śakunam caiva nairāśya vimalau ubhau ॥1-28-6॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.
translations.hindi: में आपके कथनानुसार ताटका को मार कर गो ब्राह्मण का हित साधन करने तथा इस देश के वासियों को सुखी करने को तैयार हूँ ॥५.। ` एवमुक्त्या धनुर्मध्ये बद्धवा मुष्टिमरिन्दमः । ज्याघोषमकरोत्तीत्र' दिशः शब्देन नादयन्‌

verses.sloka: यौगंधर विनिद्रौ च दैत्य प्रमधनौ तथा ।शुचि बाहुर् महाबाहुर् निष्कलि विरुचर् तथासार्चिर्माली धृतिमाली वृत्तिमान् रुचिरः तथा ॥१-२८-७॥
verses.transliteration: yaugaṁdhara vinidrau ca daitya pramadhanau tathā ।śuci bāhur mahābāhur niṣkali virucar tathāsārcirmālī dhṛtimālī vṛttimān ruciraḥ tathā ॥1-28-7॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.
translations.hindi: उस शब्द को सुन ताटका के बन में रहने वाले जीवधारी बहुत ` डरे.। ताटका उस शब्द को सुन बहुत कुपित हुई किन्तु उस समय अपना कत्तेव्य निश्चित न कर सकी

verses.sloka: पित्र्यः सौमनसः चैव विधूत मकरौ उभौ ।परवीरम् रतिम् चैव धन धान्यौ च राघव ॥१-२८-८॥
verses.transliteration: pitryaḥ saumanasaḥ caiva vidhūta makarau ubhau ।paravīram ratim caiva dhana dhānyau ca rāghava ॥1-28-8॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

verses.sloka: कामरूपम् कामरुचिम् मोहम् आवरणम् तथा ।जृंभकम् सर्पनाथम् च पन्थान वरणौ तथा ॥१-२८-९॥
verses.transliteration: kāmarūpam kāmarucim moham āvaraṇam tathā ।jṛṁbhakam sarpanātham ca panthāna varaṇau tathā ॥1-28-9॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

verses.sloka: कृशाश्व तनयान् राम भास्वरान् काम रूपिणः ।प्रतीच्छ मम भद्रम् ते पात्र भूतोऽसि राघव ॥१-२८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśva tanayān rāma bhāsvarān kāma rūpiṇaḥ ।pratīccha mama bhadram te pātra bhūto'si rāghava ॥1-28-10॥

translations.english: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.
translations.hindi: देखो लक्ष्मण ! इस यक्षिणी का शरीर कैसा भयङ्कर और बिकट है । इसे देखते ही डरपोकों के हृदय तो काँप उठते होंगे

verses.sloka: बाढम् इति एव काकुत्स्थ प्रहृष्टेन अंतरात्मना ।दिव्य भास्वर देहाः च मूर्तिमन्तः सुखप्रदाः ॥१-२८-११॥
verses.transliteration: bāḍham iti eva kākutstha prahṛṣṭena aṁtarātmanā ।divya bhāsvara dehāḥ ca mūrtimantaḥ sukhapradāḥ ॥1-28-11॥

translations.english: "Certainly" said Rama, and with a delighted heart received the astras. Some of the astra devatas were coal-black, some like smoke, some resembled rays of Sun or Moon. Assuming corporal forms, with shining, divine bodies, those weapons the their bodies bent down and palms folder they spoke to Rama in a gentle voice: "O tiger among men, here we are, What can we do for you"?
translations.hindi: देखो, इस विकट मायाविनी और दुर्जेया के कान और नाक काट कर, मैं अभी इसे भगाए देता हूँ

verses.sloka: केचिद् अंगार सदृशाः केचिद् धूम उपमाः तथा ।चन्द्र अर्क सदृशाः केचित् प्रह्व अंजलि पुटाः तथा ॥१-२८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: kecid aṁgāra sadṛśāḥ kecid dhūma upamāḥ tathā ।candra arka sadṛśāḥ kecit prahva aṁjali puṭāḥ tathā ॥1-28-12॥

translations.english: "Certainly" said Rama, and with a delighted heart received the astras. Some of the astra devatas were coal-black, some like smoke, some resembled rays of Sun or Moon. Assuming corporal forms, with shining, divine bodies, those weapons the their bodies bent down and palms folder they spoke to Rama in a gentle voice: "O tiger among men, here we are, What can we do for you"?

verses.sloka: रामम् प्रांजलयो भूत्वा अब्रुवन् मधुर भाषिणः ।इमे स्म नरशार्दूल शाधि किम् करवाम ते ॥१-२८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: rāmam prāṁjalayo bhūtvā abruvan madhura bhāṣiṇaḥ ।ime sma naraśārdūla śādhi kim karavāma te ॥1-28-13॥

translations.english: "Certainly" said Rama, and with a delighted heart received the astras. Some of the astra devatas were coal-black, some like smoke, some resembled rays of Sun or Moon. Assuming corporal forms, with shining, divine bodies, those weapons the their bodies bent down and palms folder they spoke to Rama in a gentle voice: "O tiger among men, here we are, What can we do for you"?

verses.sloka: गम्यताम् इति तान् आह यथा इष्टम् रघुनन्दनः ।मानसाः कार्य कालेषु साहाय्यम् मे करिष्यथ ॥१-२८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: gamyatām iti tān āha yathā iṣṭam raghunandanaḥ ।mānasāḥ kārya kāleṣu sāhāyyam me kariṣyatha ॥1-28-14॥

translations.english: Rama spoke to them (astra devatas) saying, "Reside in my mind and render assistance in times of need. Now you can go according to your will".
translations.hindi: यह देख ब्रह्मषि विश्वामित्र ने “हुँ” कह कर, उसे डपटा ओर श्रीरामचन्द्र-लक्ष्मण को आशीर्वाद दे कर कहा कि तुम्हारी जय हो

verses.sloka: अथ ते रामम् आमन्त्र्य कृत्वा च अपि प्रदक्षिणम् ।एवम् अस्तु इति काकुत्स्थम् उक्त्वा जग्मुः यथाआगतम् ॥१-२८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: atha te rāmam āmantrya kṛtvā ca api pradakṣiṇam ।evam astu iti kākutstham uktvā jagmuḥ yathāāgatam ॥1-28-15॥

translations.english: Thereafter those devatas having said, "Be it so", circumambulated Rama, took leave of him and returned to their respective abodes from where they had come.

verses.sloka: स च तान् राघवो ज्ञात्वा विश्वामित्रम् महामुनिम् ।गच्छन् एव अथ मधुरम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-२८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca tān rāghavo jñātvā viśvāmitram mahāmunim ।gacchan eva atha madhuram ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt ॥1-28-16॥

translations.english: After having acquired the knowledge of the weapons Rama addressed maharshi Viswamitra in gentle and soft words while walking along with him.
translations.hindi: ताटका ने ऐसी माया रची कि, वह छिपे-छिपे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी और लक्ष्मण पर पत्थरों की वर्षा करती रही । यह देख श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी अत्यन्त क्रद्ध हुए

verses.sloka: किम् एतन् मेघ संकाशम् पर्वतस्य अविदूरतः ।वृक्ष खण्डम् इतः भाति परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे ॥१-२८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: kim etan megha saṁkāśam parvatasya avidūrataḥ ।vṛkṣa khaṇḍam itaḥ bhāti param kautūhalam hi me ॥1-28-17॥

translations.english: "From this side of the mountain, not faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.

verses.sloka: दर्शनीयम् मृगाअकीर्णम् मनोहरम् अतीव च ।नाना प्रकारैः शकुनैः वल्गुभाषैः अलंकृतम् ॥१-२८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: darśanīyam mṛgāakīrṇam manoharam atīva ca ।nānā prakāraiḥ śakunaiḥ valgubhāṣaiḥ alaṁkṛtam ॥1-28-18॥

translations.english: "From this side of the mountain, not faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.
translations.hindi: सुजाओं के कट जाने से शान्त, किन्तु तिस पर भी उसे गरजते हुए अपने समीप आते देख और क्रुद्ध हो, लक्ष्मण जी ने उसके नाक-कान काट डाले

verses.sloka: निःसृताः स्म मुनिश्रेष्ठ कान्तारात् रोमहर्षणात् ।अनया तु अवगच्छामि देशस्य सुखवत्तया ॥१-२८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: niḥsṛtāḥ sma muniśreṣṭha kāntārāt romaharṣaṇāt ।anayā tu avagacchāmi deśasya sukhavattayā ॥1-28-19॥

translations.english: O best of acetics, I think we have come out of that awesome (horripilating) forest because of the pleasant feeling experienced in this region. Whose hermitage is this? O Revered one tell me".

verses.sloka: सर्वम् मे शंस भगवन् कस्य आश्रम पदम् तु इदम् ।संप्राप्ताः यत्र ते पापाः ब्रह्मघ्नाः दुष्ट चारिणः ॥१-२८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sarvam me śaṁsa bhagavan kasya āśrama padam tu idam ।saṁprāptāḥ yatra te pāpāḥ brahmaghnāḥ duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ ॥1-28-20॥

translations.english: O great ascetic, O venerable brahmana, from where do those slayers of brahmanas, doers of cruel acts, wickedminded and sinful persons come from and cause obstacles to your sacrifice? Where is that sacrificial place required to be protected by me? Where are these rakshasas required to be slain? O best of ascetics, I would like to hear from you". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
